create_swimmer_env: create a SwimmerEnv instance to initialize the MuJoCo swimmer simulation environment
run_swimmer_step: run a single simulation step on the swimmer environment with a given action
reset_swimmer_model: reset the swimmer model to a random initial joint angle and return the observation
get_swimmer_observation: get the current observation vector from the swimmer environment state
set_swimmer_env_state: set the swimmer environment state by providing position and velocity dictionaries
